changedBehavior: An available update shows its release notes in a collapsed What's new expander below Update now in About, parsed from the existing update-check response into inert plain-text headings, bullets and paragraphs, with GitHub links for truncated or missing notes.
expectedAssertions: Release bodies from the existing latest-release response become plain-text headings, bullets and paragraphs; links, images, HTML, scripts and comments never survive as markup, and empty or markup-only bodies yield no notes.
Long notes are truncated at a fixed character limit and flagged for the View full notes on GitHub link.
About shows a collapsed What's new in X.Y.Z expander directly below Update now, without nested scrolling or rich/web content, and only explicit GitHub links open the browser.
Expanded notes are readable in light, dark and Windows high contrast; empty notes fall back to View release notes on GitHub without affecting update checks.
